subject.why: The dock, posts, rope coil, and pirate flag match the brief.

category.why: The structure rests naturally in a wide plane of water under an open sky.

clean.why: Free of UI, text, watermarks, and characters.

framing.why: The dock cuts off abruptly at the right edge rather than keeping clear side margins.

colour.why: Vibrant, warm wood tones that contrast well with the bright blue water and sky.

detail.why: Features clean, chunky shapes without clutter or micro-textures.

style.why: Consistent with references in its smooth 3D forms and satin finish.

fix: Pull the camera back to keep the entire dock contained within the frame with comfortable margins on the right.
